concerns.text: FR‑021 requires R² > 0.6 on the held‑out test set, but no task verifies or enforces this threshold. T020/T021/T022 only check artifact creation and basic metrics, leaving the success criterion uncovered.
Constitution III mandates SHA‑256 checksums for all raw data files, yet T001’s verification manifest only records directory creation. No task computes or records checksums for downloaded raw files.

Constitution V requires a content‑hash record for every artifact in `state/projects/PROJ-376‑predicting‑corrosion‑potential‑from‑comp.yaml`. No task updates this versioning map after any artifact is produced.
SC‑005 (total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) is not measured by any task. A timing or benchmark task is needed to capture overall execution time.
T020/T021 verification steps do not include a check that the R² > 0.6 threshold (FR‑021) is satisfied; they only assert that model files exist.
T022’s learnability logic enforces R² > 0.0, p < 0.05 and RMSE < 150 mV, but does not incorporate the additional FR‑021 R² > 0.6 condition, leaving the primary success criterion unvalidated.
